Lumen delivery card: formal packages include the subtitle file, review report,
and picture version identifier.

pages.text:
Lumen timing card: a cue ending exactly on a cut is acceptable; extending
beyond a cut requires explicit timing review.

signature before export.

Lumen glossary card: approved terminology changes require a language lead

pages.text:
Lumen retry card: delivery retries keep the same package ID and checksum when
no content has changed.

paragraphs.text:
Lumen retry card: delivery retries keep the same package ID and checksum when

pages.text:
Lumen correction card: a changed subtitle file receives a new package ID even
when the picture version is unchanged.

paragraphs.text:
Lumen correction card: a changed subtitle file receives a new package ID even

pages.text:
Lumen turnaround card: urgent fixes have a 4-hour review target; urgency does
not waive either review gate.

paragraphs.text:

pages.text:
Lumen terminology: QC means quality control and includes timing checks, not
only spelling checks.

pages.text: Lumen archival card: formal review reports are retained for 5 years.

paragraphs.text: Lumen archival card: formal review reports are retained for 5 years.

pages.text:
Lumen preview card: preview exports carry a visible PREVIEW label and are
never cached as the formal release.

paragraphs.text:
Lumen preview card: preview exports carry a visible PREVIEW label and are

pages.text:
Lumen accessibility card: SDH cues identify essential off-screen alarms and
meaningful music changes.

paragraphs.text:

pages.text: Lumen frame card: one frame at 25 frames per second lasts 40 milliseconds.

paragraphs.text: Lumen frame card: one frame at 25 frames per second lasts 40 milliseconds.

Lumen conflict card: two reviewers disagreeing about a proper name escalate to
the language lead and the glossary owner.

pages.text:

replacing undecodable characters.
